thread:
marta-partnerships: Urgent FYI 1: Cloudwave (AWS Marketplace) order is stuck. Their procurement insists on SFTP EDI 850 only and our seller alias isn't resolving. Also they added a data residency clause (UK-only) in the PO. We have a joint launch planned next Tuesday. Can procurement/legal/eng triage?

marketplace-bot: ingest_error external_id=PO-CW-5522 status=422 error_key=UNRESOLVED_SELLER details="alias 'redwood-uk-legacy' not found"

noah-procurement: They won't accept PDF or manual portal entry for production orders. EDI SFTP is mandatory. Do we have a seller_id to give them? If not, can we map alias quickly?

tessa-sales: PO=PO-CW-5522, EIN=23-9876543. Their ops says seller_id should be seller-cw-987 but our portal lists redwood-uk-legacy. Marketing is on the line; delaying the launch hurts the co-marketing timeline.

irina-legal: Reviewed PO redlines. We cannot agree to UK-only deployment. Proposed reply: we will comply with applicable export/localization laws and offer a paid private deployment addendum for UK-only guarantees. Also cannot accept unilateral indemnity expansion. I'll draft a 2-bullet counter now.

omar-engineering: Tech quick take 1: alias mapping is trivial if we have partner console access. EDI SFTP inbound we don't support yet; engineering estimate for a minimal parser + SFTP drop adapter ~72 hours. Alternative: ask Cloudwave to map their seller_id to our existing alias on their side (1 call). If marketing needs launch next week, fastest path is get Cloudwave to flip alias mapping and we accept a temporary manual accounting entry.

marta-partnerships: Action items proposed: 1) Irina to send the legal counter + acceptable exception language by EOD. 2) Omar to request partner console access or prepare the 72h adapter plan. 3) Noah to ask Cloudwave to map seller_id -> our alias and open EDI onboarding ticket. 4) Tessa to flag marketing hold if not green by Mon 10:00 PT.

noah-procurement: Calling Cloudwave ops now to request seller_id mapping and to confirm EDI onboarding timeline.

omar-engineering: If partner won't flip mapping, I'll start the adapter prototype and post ETA.

irina-legal: Counter sent (see thread attachment). Exception template included for manual accounting entry for up to 72h.

marketplace-bot: reingest_attempt external_id=PO-CW-5522 status=200 details="accepted after seller alias update"

tessa-sales: Cloudwave confirmed alias mapping updated. Re-ingest succeeded. Marketing keeps the launch date.

marta-partnerships: Closing loop: alias map fixed by partner ops, legal counter accepted as addendum option, EDI onboarding still pending. Thanks team.
